# Codex Autopilot Kit

> Project-scoped, zero-runtime-dependency multi-agent autopilot layer for Codex.

Repository: https://github.com/crunaldo/codex-autopilot-kit
Configurator: https://crunaldo.github.io/codex-autopilot-kit/
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/codex-autopilot-kit
License: MIT
Node.js: 20+
CLI: codex-autopilot

## Purpose

Codex Autopilot Kit adds a repository-local `.codex/` agent stack and reusable autonomous Goal contracts to an existing Codex project. It does not replace Codex, install a separate agent runtime, or modify the user's global `~/.codex` configuration.

Default roles:
- supervisor: selected by the user in Codex; owns planning, delegation, evaluation, escalation, and stopping;
- explorer: GPT-6 Luna, read-only, targeted discovery;
- worker: GPT-6 Luna, implementation/debugging/testing;
- reviewer: GPT-6 Luna, read-only independent review.

Default concurrency is 1.

## Preferred installation for humans

Use the visual configurator or run from the target repository root:

    npx --yes codex-autopilot-kit init --target .

The GitHub source remains available as a fallback:

    npx --yes github:crunaldo/codex-autopilot-kit init --target .

## Preferred installation for coding agents

Read `INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md` first. Use the non-interactive preview before writing:

    npx --yes codex-autopilot-kit init --target . --preset generic --profile balanced --concurrency 1 --yes --dry-run

Then inspect:

    npx --yes codex-autopilot-kit diff --target . --profile balanced --preset generic --concurrency 1 --json

Install only after the desired configuration is confirmed:

    npx --yes codex-autopilot-kit init --target . --preset generic --profile balanced --concurrency 1 --yes

Verify:

    npx --yes codex-autopilot-kit doctor --target . --json

## Visual configurator contract

The public configurator is a static client-side UI. Its shareable URL encodes `preset`, `profile`, `concurrency`, and `lang`. Generated commands must correspond exactly to that state. The core state/command logic lives in `configurator/core.js` and is covered by automated tests across all supported combinations.

## Safety invariants

- Never modify `~/.codex`.
- Stay inside the target project.
- Back up managed files before replacement.
- Do not use `--force` against an unmanaged `.codex/config.toml` without explicit authorization.
- Do not commit, push, release, deploy, rotate credentials, or weaken tests merely to complete installation.
- Explorer and reviewer remain read-only by default.
- No nested subagents.
- No package runtime dependencies.

## CLI commands

- `init` — interactive or fully specified project setup.
- `install` — lower-level install/update command.
- `diff` — inspection-only current-vs-desired comparison.
- `doctor` — validate managed files and role configuration; supports `--json`.
- `status` — inspect installed manifest; supports `--json`.
- `uninstall` — remove managed files; can restore latest backup.
- `print-goal` — print a Goal preset.

`init --dry-run` and `install --dry-run` do not write files.

## Presets

- `generic` — general software work.
- `frontend-visual` — evidence-driven visual/frontend workflow.
- `backend` — backend/API/service implementation and verification.

## Profiles

- `economy` — explorer medium, worker medium, reviewer high.
- `balanced` — explorer medium, worker high, reviewer high; recommended default.
- `quality` — explorer high, worker high, reviewer high.

No profile enables maximum reasoning automatically.

## Canonical documentation

- `README.md` — primary English overview and quick start.
- `README.es.md` — Spanish parity documentation.
- `INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md` — deterministic agent installation contract.
- `docs/GETTING_STARTED.md` — installation and first-run guide.
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` — architecture and role separation.
- `docs/MODEL_STRATEGY.md` — model/reasoning strategy.
- `docs/GOAL_PLAYBOOK.md` — Goal usage patterns.
- `docs/SAFETY.md` — safety model.
- `docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md` — troubleshooting.
- `docs/DISTRIBUTION.md` — release and distribution channels.
- `CHANGELOG.md` — shipped changes.
- `ROADMAP.md` — planned work.

## Managed target files

    .codex/config.toml
    .codex/agents/explorer.toml
    .codex/agents/worker.toml
    .codex/agents/reviewer.toml
    .codex/autopilot-kit.json
    AUTOPILOT-GOAL.md

Local backups are stored under `.codex-autopilot-backups/` and ignored by git.

## Autonomous Goal start

After installation, start a NEW Codex chat so project-local configuration reloads, then use the installed `AUTOPILOT-GOAL.md` contract with `/goal`.

## Distribution

The unscoped `codex-autopilot-kit` package is published on npm; query the registry for the current `latest` version. GitHub remains the canonical source repository. npm release automation uses staged publishing with provenance and a manual approval boundary.

## Project identity

Codex Autopilot Kit is a community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI. Product names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
